data.text:
After more than a decade of silence, one of the country’s most iconic Pride events is making a blazing comeback.

Mentorque Productions president and chief executive officer Bryan Dy officially announces the return of White Party Manila, unveiling its 2026 edition titled “White Party Manila: Reignite.” The event marks the revival of the once-legendary celebration after 12 years of “hibernation,” promising a grand, high-energy night for the LGBTQIA+ community and its allies.

The event aims to merge fashion, music, and advocacy into one immersive spectacle where “fashion meets rave, and style becomes a collective force.” Organizers say the comeback is more than just a party—it is a symbolic rebirth of love, freedom, and pride where “every color and every story is equal.”

White Party Manila: Reignite is scheduled on June 27, 2026 at the World Trade Center in Pasay City, positioning itself as one of the biggest highlights of the country’s Pride Month celebrations.

The event also carries a strong advocacy component. Organizers announce that the party will be held for the benefit of LoveYourself, a nonprofit organization known for promoting self-love, sexual health awareness, and community care among Filipinos, particularly within the LGBTQIA+ sector.

“With purpose at its core, we are reigniting the fire for a cause,” the announcement states, emphasizing that the event will combine entertainment with meaningful community impact.

With its return, White Party Manila aims to once again gather thousands of revelers dressed in white, uniting under a shared celebration of diversity, equality, and pride. Organizers are expected to reveal more details, including ambassadors, performers, and partners, in the coming months.
